d03.hatespeech_hatespeech.template: Does this comment contain hate speech?
d03.hatespeech_hatespeech.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_hatespeech.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who answered YES to 'does this comment contain hate speech' (bias-motivated, hostile and malicious language targeted at a person or group because of their actual or perceived innate characteristics); an annotator who answered 'unclear' counts as half. Not whether the comment mentions a group, and not an intensity score

d03.hatespeech_sentiment.template: Is the overall sentiment of this comment negative?
d03.hatespeech_sentiment.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_sentiment.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who rated the comment's overall sentiment 'somewhat negative' or 'strongly negative'; 'neutral' and either positive rating count as no. Negative in tone, not merely about a negative topic

d03.hatespeech_respect.template: Is this comment disrespectful toward the group it targets?
d03.hatespeech_respect.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_respect.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who rated the comment 'disrespectful' or 'strongly disrespectful' toward the group(s) it targets; 'neutral', 'respectful' and 'strongly respectful' count as no. Asks about DISrespect -- yes means disrespectful

d03.hatespeech_insult.template: Is this comment insulting toward the group it targets?
d03.hatespeech_insult.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_insult.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who agreed or strongly agreed that the comment is insulting toward the group(s) it targets; 'neither disagree nor agree' counts as half, disagree as no

d03.hatespeech_humiliate.template: Is this comment humiliating toward the group it targets?
d03.hatespeech_humiliate.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_humiliate.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who agreed or strongly agreed that the comment is humiliating toward the group(s) it targets; 'neither disagree nor agree' counts as half, disagree as no

d03.hatespeech_status.template: Does this comment state that the group it targets is inferior?
d03.hatespeech_status.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_status.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who said the comment states that the targeted group(s) are 'inferior' or 'strongly inferior'; 'neither superior nor inferior' and either 'superior' rating count as no. Yes only for inferiority, not for superiority or for no status claim

d03.hatespeech_dehumanize.template: Does this comment dehumanize the group it targets, for example by comparing its members to animals?
d03.hatespeech_dehumanize.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_dehumanize.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who agreed or strongly agreed that the comment dehumanizes the group(s) it targets (e.g. by comparing them to an animal); 'neither disagree nor agree' counts as half, disagree as no

d03.hatespeech_violence.template: Does this comment call for using violence against the group it targets?
d03.hatespeech_violence.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_violence.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who agreed or strongly agreed that the comment calls for using violence against the group(s) it targets; 'neither disagree nor agree' counts as half, disagree as no. A call for violence, not a mere mention or description of violence

d03.hatespeech_genocide.template: Does this comment call for the deliberate killing of a large number of people from the group it targets?
d03.hatespeech_genocide.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_genocide.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who agreed or strongly agreed that the comment calls for the deliberate killing of a large group of people from the group(s) it targets; 'neither disagree nor agree' counts as half, disagree as no

d03.hatespeech_attack_defend.template: Does this comment attack the group it targets, rather than defend it or do neither?
d03.hatespeech_attack_defend.state_kind: one social-media comment (Reddit, Twitter or YouTube) from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, as plain text; each comment was annotated with respect to the identity group(s) it targets
d03.hatespeech_attack_defend.answer_meaning: the share of annotators who rated the comment 'attacking' or 'strongly attacking' the group(s) it targets; 'neither defending nor attacking', 'defending' and 'strongly defending' count as no. One-sided: yes means attacking, NOT 'attacking or defending'
